externalTools.reason: ACP adapter for Claude Code; brings the proprietary @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (D1). The user installs it; the OTheater executable neither loads nor distributes it.
Proprietary Claude SDK (D1); only as part of the executor the user installs.

OpenCode client; platform packages have no license field (D4). External executor.
ccusage 20.0.48 (MIT, published 2026-11-02): reads the consumption of the clients' logs. A CLI the user installs, run as a separate process by the usage-ccusage adapter, never imported or bundled.

_notes.acceptedInDependencies: Each item: { license, decidedBy, date, reason, source }. Valid for levels B and D. Never opens a forbidden license.
_notes.packageExceptions: Each item: { package, versions (semver range, optional), license (exact text the tool reads, optional), scope ('production' | 'development' | 'any'), allowForbidden (true only if the owner decides an exception for GPL/AGPL/LGPL), decidedBy, date, reason, source }.
_notes.externalTools: Level C programs run as a separate process and installed by the user. One that shows up as a bundled dependency (level B) fails the check.
_notes.credentialAllowlist: Each item: { path (repository-relative; a trailing '/' means a directory), decidedBy, date, reason, source }. Future home of browser.secret_paths. Only what the owner decided and recorded.
